quad_causality.mechanism: The D8 rows are one-way inequalities toward the inherited strict-minimum node; they do not impose four-way equality. Three rows bind at the SLSQP solution while the exempt target has no outgoing witness row. The convex least-squares second-difference objective then equalizes this free, unbounded-by-active-box patch. This is an objective/active-inequality interaction, not float32 collapse or a D8 cycle.

B_to_H_scalar_diagnostic.definition: h(alpha)=float32(B + alpha*(H-B)); calculations only in memory. Values below are constraint boundaries/witness diagnostics, not a selected alpha and not a candidate.

focus_25pct_real_line_thresholds.note: At the exact EW crossing, one final float32 cast is marginally above the prominence limit; the energy boundary below is stricter and its float32 diagnostic passes both focus gates.

fixed_stencil_energy_25pct_boundary.scope_note: One in-memory line diagnostic only; no candidate, solver call, alpha selection, or full independent consumer run.
fixed_stencil_energy_25pct_boundary.comparison_note: Esta es la puerta de energía del consumidor independiente; no el coste del autor. El coste del autor multiplicado por 2 difiere de la suma de stencils del consumidor.

rounding_boundary_for_this_specific_quad.interpretation: For the four affine values approaching the EV91 common value from below, all round to that common float32 value beyond this threshold. This is a near-endpoint quantization interval; no nextafter repair was performed.

B_to_H_scalar_diagnostic.claim_limit: The energy-boundary point is a single analytically derived diagnostic witness, not a chosen production alpha. It proves the existing shape gates, 25% energy reduction and 2-degree local angle reduction can coexist at one non-flat float32 point on this line. It does not prove every alpha in the scalar-constraint interval passes every global/physical/compiled consumer gate; no full consumer was run.
